note: Phase 6 Architecture is NEW under Shape A (2026-04-24). Owner: @architect. Reads PRD + UX-spec + brand-guidelines + tech-stack — first phase where all four are simultaneously available. Produces architecture.md (sacred) + architecture.meta.json sidecar + ADRs (incl. REQUIRED ADRs for `flag_for_architecture_ADR` deltas inherited from Phase 5 reconciliation). Check #5 (architecture-adrs-for-flagged-deltas-emitted) is the silent-divergence guard — block-severity.
entry_conditions: `coldpress.yaml baselines:` present with a11y axis declared

acceptance_checks.description: PRD `_context/sacred/prd.md` is locked (re-verified at Phase 6 exit; staleness check vs phase-5-to-6 handoff)
acceptance_checks.remediation: If PRD was edited mid-Phase-6, route through architecture-deltas reconciliation pass (forward-carry) OR re-run from architecture-design Step 0 with refreshed graph.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/sacred/architecture.md` exists with `sacred: true` frontmatter, validates against `schemas/sacred-docs/architecture.schema.json`
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@architect architecture-design` to author the system architecture document.
Re-run `architecture-design` Step 6 — sidecar is emitted alongside architecture.md.

acceptance_checks.description: At least 1 ADR exists at `_context/planning/adrs/adr-NNN-*.md` from Phase 6 (some Phase 6 runs will produce many; at least 1 expected for a non-trivial project)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `architecture-design` Step 5 — author at least one ADR for a Phase 6 architectural decision.

acceptance_checks.description: SILENT-DIVERGENCE GUARD. For every entry in `phase-5-to-6 handoff.architecture_adrs_required[]`, a corresponding ADR exists with `resolves_design_delta: <delta_id>` field. Phase 6 cannot exit until every flagged delta has its matching ADR — converts silent PRD↔design divergence into auditable architectural-decision provenance.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `architecture-design` Step 1 (flagged-deltas-intake) followed by Step 5 (ADR authoring). Each flagged delta requires one ADR with `resolves_design_delta: <delta_id>`, `prd_section_affected`, `design_decision_taken`, `architecture_implication`, `prd_amendment_deferred_reason`.

acceptance_checks.description: Every external dependency referenced in `architecture.md` is in `tech-stack.md.dependencies` OR has a Phase 3 ADR amendment authorising the addition
acceptance_checks.remediation: For each unverified import: either remove from architecture (scope-reduce) OR re-enter Phase 3 to add via ADR amendment (`stack-locking` baselines block re-run / new ADR).

acceptance_checks.description: Every NFR axis from PRD has corresponding architectural implementation strategy in `architecture.md` Section 5 (or equivalent)
acceptance_checks.remediation: If any NFR axis is unaddressed, return to `architecture-design` Step 4 (NFR strategy). Most NFR gaps surface as architecture-deltas (forward-carry to Phase 7).

acceptance_checks.description: BREADTH-COVERAGE EXIT CHECK (D10 adopt 2 — BMAD upstream). architecture.md carries a `## Dimension Coverage` section (or the meta sidecar a `dimension_coverage` map) in which every canonical architecture dimension — data model, API/contracts, auth/authz, state & concurrency, error handling, observability, deployment topology, scaling/performance, security posture, external integrations — is tagged exactly one of `decided` | `deferred` | `open`. No dimension may be silently absent: a dimension the project genuinely doesn't need is `decided` with a one-line 'N/A because…'. The gate does not require every dimension to be *decided* — only that none is *unaddressed*. Complements `trace-orphans-clean` (which guards requirement→component→ADR provenance) with decision-space completeness.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Return to `architecture-design` and add/complete the `## Dimension Coverage` section — tag each canonical dimension decided/deferred/open. A `deferred` or `open` dimension is legitimate (forward-carries as an architecture-delta to Phase 7); a *missing* one is the failure this check catches.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/handoffs/phase-6-to-7-{date}.md` exists, valid against extended phase-handoff schema (includes `agent_transitions:` for Pattern 7; optional `architecture_deltas:` if forward-carry mechanism activated)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Invoke `phase-transition` at Phase 6 exit. Phase 7 entry skill consumes the handoff (especially `architecture_deltas:` if any).

acceptance_checks.description: diagram-creator has emitted Mermaid (system-context + component minimum) + diagram index at `_context/design/diagrams/v{N}/`. Architecture.md has `## Diagrams` section cross-referencing emitted files.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@architect diagram-creator` after `architecture-design` locks. Minimum: 1 system-context + 1 component diagram covering every ArchitectureComponent node.

acceptance_checks.description: `coldpress trace orphans --strict` reports no blocking findings — every flag_for_architecture_ADR delta has a matching ADR, no unresolved deltas, no dangling dependencies. `--strict` (WS10-E2) rejects a vacuous pass on an empty graph. The requirement→story orphan check correctly does NOT fire at P6 (stories aren't authored until P7 — WS10-C4 ordering fix); it activates at the P7 gate.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `coldpress trace orphans` and resolve each finding: map the requirement to a component, add the missing ADR, or resolve the delta.

acceptance_checks.description: The architecture doc `_context/sacred/architecture.md` names at least one approver (`approvers[]`). Folds the retired Conftest `architecture_has_approvers` policy into the Phase-6 exit gate — every material architecture change lands with an accountable approver.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Add at least one named approver to the architecture.md frontmatter `approvers[]`.
